application_fee.details: The non-refundable fee must be paid online. Proof of fee payment must be attached to the printed application after writing the applicant’s name on the receipt.

selection_process: Screening or shortlisting of applications Written Test in the relevant field or trade Trade Test in the relevant specialization Document verification
candidates up to six times the number of vacancies may be shortlisted for the Trade Test. The final merit list will be prepared based on the Written Test and Trade Test.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.nituk.ac.in.
Open the recruitment section and find Advertisement No. 08/2026.
Read the advertisement and applicable Recruitment Rules carefully.
Complete the online application for the required post.
Pay the applicable application fee online.
Submit the online form by 4 November 2026.
Download and print the submitted application.
Attach the fee receipt and self-attested copies of supporting documents.
Place the application in a sealed envelope.
Write “Application for the post of __________” on the envelope.
Send the application so that it reaches NIT Uttarakhand by 11 November 2026, 5:30 PM.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate online and hard-copy applications for each post.
important_instructions: Online submission alone is not sufficient; the hard copy must also reach the institute before the deadline. Applications received after 11 November 2026 at 5:30 PM will not be considered. Incomplete applications or applications without supporting documents will be rejected. Government and PSU employees must apply through the proper channel or produce an NOC. Original documents must be produced during document verification. No travelling allowance will be paid for attending the selection process. The institute will publish the shortlist and recruitment updates only on its website. The number of vacancies may be increased, decreased or cancelled. Female candidates are especially encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: Post-Wise Qualification
content_sections.text: For the prescribed qualification under the Recruitment Rules, candidates should possess: First Class Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in any discipline; or Master’s degree in any discipline with at least 50% marks or an equivalent grade. Knowledge of computer applications, including word processing and spreadsheets. Officials applying through deputation must hold an analogous post or have the prescribed regular service in the feeder grade specified in the Recruitment Rules. Candidates should possess any one of the following qualifications in the relevant field: First Class B.E., B.Tech. or MCA First Class Diploma in Engineering First Class Bachelor’s degree in Science Master’s degree in Science with at least 50% marks or an equivalent grade Deputation applicants must satisfy the analogous-post or feeder-grade service conditions prescribed in the NIT Recruitment Rules. The prescribed educational routes include: Senior Secondary/Class 12 with Science and at least 60% marks; or Senior Secondary/Class 12 with at least 50% marks and a one-year or longer ITI course in the appropriate trade; or Class 10 with at least 60% marks and a two-year ITI certificate in the appropriate trade; or Three-year Diploma in Engineering in the relevant field. Applicants must also satisfy the applicable experience and feeder-grade conditions for deputation or short-term contract. Candidates should possess any one of the following: Class 12 with Science and at least 60% marks; or Class 12 with at least 50% marks and a one-year or longer ITI course in the appropriate trade; or Class 10 with at least 60% marks and a two-year ITI certificate in the appropriate trade; or Three-year Diploma in Engineering in the relevant field. Candidates should have passed Class 12 from a recognized board and possess: Minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute; and Proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheets. Proficiency in other computer skills is desirable.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The applicable age limit will depend on the mode of appointment and the NIT Recruitment Rules 2019. Age, qualification and experience will be calculated as of 4 November 2026. Relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, PwD and Ex-servicemen candidates will be provided according to Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will include: Screening or shortlisting of applications Written Test in the relevant field or trade Trade Test in the relevant specialization Document verification Based on written-test marks, candidates up to six times the number of vacancies may be shortlisted for the Trade Test. The final merit list will be prepared based on the Written Test and Trade Test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under NIT Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 21 non-teaching vacancies have been announced.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are included in the recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts are Superintendent, Technical Assistant, Technician (Selection Grade-II), Technician and Junior Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date for submitting the hard copy?
faq.answer: The hard copy must reach NIT Uttarakhand by 11 November 2026 up to 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The Technical Assistant post carries Level 6 pay of ₹35,400–1,12,400. The consolidated contractual remuneration is ₹57,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates need Class 12, a typing speed of 35 words per minute and proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheets.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500 for Superintendent and Technical Assistant and ₹250 for the other posts. SC, ST, women, Divyaang and deputation applicants are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection will be made through a Written Test, Trade Test and document verification.
